notes.title: June 2017 Schedule
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have some news to convey to you guys.

"The Morgue Fissure Between Worlds" Is still being worked on. I haven't abandoned the project. As you all know, Chapter 2 was supposed to be released in May, but I had quite a few heartbreaking setbacks. 

First, I have learned a lesson. Never work on a project without constantly keeping a consistent backup. Near the end of May just a week prior to releasing Chapter 2; My entire Hardrive failed. It reached the end of its life. I tried recovering the data, but nothing worked....It was dead....and dead forever.

Luckily I had a backup...The problem was the last time I did a backup was halfway done with chapter 1....So I had to restart the development process. However, it hasn't taken me long to get that fixed and back up and running. 

Second, there was an un-expected death in the family just a few weeks ago....but this will not stop me from working on this game. 

Lastly, after all these setbacks Chapter 2 is still coming along nicely. I am happy to announce that It will be available before July 2017 as a free update. If you have any questions just let me know.

Thanks! -Zoltoks

notes.title: Graphic Update + Optimization 1.2
notes.content:
This small update optimizes chapter 1. It also adds some new shaders to make the game pop.

Changes
*Fixed lighting and textures on house walls.
*Added new graphic shader.
*Optimized Chapter 1. (Especially in water area)
*Added small details in some areas.
*Fixed more collision issues.

Chapter 2 Update is coming soon! Lots of stuff is in store. Stay tuned! 

-Zoltoks

notes.title: Sale Ending Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I just wanted to let you know that "The Morgue Fissure Between Worlds" will have its launch sale removed today. Make sure to pick up a copy while it's still on sale!

Also, Chapter 2 is coming together very quickly and nicely. It should have an early release by the end of April!

Thanks, Zoltok

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 1.1
notes.content:
This update fixes some issues currently found in chapter 1. 

*Many collision problems have been fixed
*Fixed some areas where textures would flicker
*Corrected some areas where there would be gaps in the floor
*Added some new ambient sounds in different locations.

That's it for now! I will post an announcement when Chapter 2 Is released!
